item.title: 5,283 Stars in 13 Days: Kiri, a Rust Container Runtime Coming for Docker Desktop's Desktop Business
item.description: libracoder/kiri opened Nov 2, shipped 6 releases in 13 days, and hit 5,283 stars / 247 forks per the GitHub API. A Rust rewrite of the whole container path, compatible with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx; container start reported at 2.55 ms (vendor-reported). Full post and discussion live on the BBS.
